snippet.title: TeaKnights Official Teaser
snippet.description:
We are making a brand-new title! Please join us on a new journey, as we make our very own sin & punishment style musical rail-shooter! With low-poly 3D graphics, just like you remember 26 years ago. 

TeaKnights is officially now IN DEVELOPMENT!

Support us if you can! It helps us continue on this journey - https://www.patreon.com/funkycandev/

Wishlist now on Steam! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4863130/TeaKnights/

#indiegame #y2k
